intro.summary: A novena honoring Our Lady of Monte Berico, recalling Mary’s apparitions at Monte Berico in Vicenza and seeking her intercession and protection.

blocks.text: You can pray the full Our Lady of Monte Berico Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. O Most Holy Virgin, Mother of God and my Mother Mary, I thank you that you have deigned to appear on Monte Berico, and I thank you for all the graces you grant here to those who turn to you. Nobody ever prayed to you in vain. I, too, resort to you and beg you, for the Passion and Death of Jesus and for your pains: welcome me, O merciful Mother, under your mantle, which is a maternal mantle. Grant me the particular grace that I ask of you

and protect me from all evil, and especially from sin, which is the greatest evil. O make, O Mary, my Mother, that I always enjoy your loving protection in life, and even more in death, and then come to see you in heaven, and to thank and bless you forever. Amen. Madonna of Monte Berico, pray for us. O sweet Virgin, pious mother of love, like this Ave rising from the heart. Repeat three times: Ave, ave, ave, Maria. O Virgin, shine as a star in the sky. Motherly defend your faithful children. Repeat three times: Ave, ave, ave, Maria. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
